resources.string: Countdown that locks your phone when it expires — runs in the background
Allow usage access to see today\'s screen time here and on the widget.
Once started, this phone limit cannot be cancelled until the timer expires.
Enter a duration greater than zero.
The timer keeps running in the background — even with the screen off — and the phone locks when it reaches zero. There is no cancel button.
Remaining time while a phone limit is running
Your phone limit has ended, but the phone could not be locked — ClearView must be a Device Admin to lock the screen. Enable it from the app: Quran tab → ⋮ → Set Phone Limit.
To lock the phone when the timer ends, ClearView must be a Device Admin. Enable it below — the system settings will open.
Device Admin lets the app lock your phone when the phone limit reaches zero. No other device-management permission is used.

ClearView is already a Device Admin, but the lock-screen policy added by this update hasn\'t been accepted yet — Android keeps the old permissions until you confirm. Open the admin settings below and tap ClearView to accept the change.
Enter a duration like 1h:20m:10s to start the phone limit.
To end and lock the phone at exactly the right moment even if the app is closed, allow exact alarms. Without this, the limit may end a few minutes late.
The remaining time shows as an ongoing notification in the status area and shade. Allow notifications to see the countdown.
Shows today\'s screen time and starts a phone limit countdown with the remaining time
